findings.description: Response.__init__ now reads self.raw.reason, but self.raw is still None at that point, so constructing any Response raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any call to Response(), including HTTPAdapter.build_response, which creates Response() before assigning response.raw. Mechanism: __init__ sets self.raw = None earlier in the same method, so accessing .reason on it fails. Impact: every HTTP request through the adapter crashes before a response is returned, and direct Response() construction fails.
